label: prf:categorical-reeb-exists
title: Proof of existence of the categorical Reeb derivation
html: The derivation \xi is the infinitesimal generator of the one-parameter subgroup T \cong \mathrm{U}(1) \subset G, and \varTheta_A is its Maurer--Cartan dual, uniquely determined by the normalisation condition.
heading: Proof
